For b,c in C, residuum Frobenius shows b->c in C, implying closure under MV complement, truncated sum and difference. Least positive d in C must divide m=n-1 by Euclidean division and truncated subtraction, and every member is a multiple of d. Conversely rounding to C_d={0,d,...,m} satisfies the adjunction and all three Frobenius compatibilities. Each d|m gives a unique ordered pair, count tau(m), and f_d1 <= f_d2 iff d2|d1 (dual divisor lattice). Independent exhaustive monotone deflationary-map enumeration n=2..9, constructing each left adjoint and checking five axioms for all x,y, returned exactly tau(n-1) pairs.
